ops.text: Minimum Coverages. RevMed shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.6 sets no minimum limits, so we add RevMed's floor coverages at our fallback position: E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000. Sanofi's self-insurance right and the existing evidence-on-request mechanic are unchanged.
input.summary: Add minimum E&O (USD 1M) and cyber (USD 2M) limits for RevMed.
